name: thinkui
description: UI references for coding agents: real screens, flows, ready-made components, fonts and animated icons over MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Real interface references for coding agents
interface.longDescription: ThinkUI answers the question a designer asks before drawing anything: what did real products ship here? Ask how a paywall frames a free trial, how a good dashboard shows an empty first run, or which typeface survives a dense table, and it returns named screens and flows from shipped products with the app each came from and the licence it carries, plus MIT-licensed UI elements, animated icons and materials. It is evidence for a design decision, not a component library to copy, and it returns an empty result rather than an approximation when the library has no answer.
defaultPrompt: How do good products frame a free trial on a paywall?
Find an empty state for a search with no results.
Which typeface holds up in a dense data table?
